snippet.title: Anime Shop Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Anime Shop Simulator, an anime shop management simulation game developed by One More Time. Players will stock an inventory of manga, figures, collectible cards, and more to run a successful anime-centric store. Anime Shop Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#AnimeShopSimulator #Gaming #IGN
